honest_interpretation: PASS on the pre-registered aggregate bar (recovery 0.703>=0.70, OOS-FP 0.028<=0.40). Decomposed: heme 16/16, PLP 14/16, ser_his 13/16 generalise strongly off-M-CSA on INDEPENDENT GOLD (EC-derived labels, non-circular) - the first gold (not bronze) off-M-CSA validation. metal_dependent_hydrolase recovers only 2/16 because the held-out used EC 3.4.24 metalloendopeptidases (metzincin/gluzincin fold) while the atlas family is metallo-beta-lactamase-fold-centric; the unrecovered metal cases ABSTAIN (TM<0.70), they do not misroute - the system fails safe. Net: structural recovery generalises beyond M-CSA for 3/4 families on gold; the metal family is a COVERAGE gap (atlas fold-narrow), not a precision failure. Abstention/precision is strong everywhere (OOS-FP 2.8%).
